status: fitted model of an outside player (E9-7); work in progress

provenance.source: arena-gen7-* and arena-gen7-1-* feeds against BEN, deal families with crc32(family) % 5 != 0

notes: Not a declared card: BEN publishes no carding. The descriptor is the reading under which its spots carry the most (count everywhere; third-and-fifth leads), and the emission tables say how its spots depend on the parity: the lowest spot by default, the highest mostly from even length.
phi 0.3 is Gen 8's factor for an unknown opponent; on held-out boards the class term at 0.3 read BEN 64 best and BEN 16 about as well as at 1.
